title: IMD issues orange alert for heavy rain in Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Odisha and East Madhya Pradesh today - News On AIR
article_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places over Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Odisha, East Madhya Pradesh today.

The IMD forecast heavy rainfall conditions at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Coastal Karnataka, East Uttar Pradesh, Gangetic West Bengal, Jharkhand, Kerala, Mahe, Madhya Maharashtra, and South Interior Karnataka for the next two to three days. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Telangana, Uttarakhand, Vidarbha, West Madhya Pradesh and North Eastern Region for the same period.

The Met department has predicted thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Interior Karnataka, Coastal Karnataka, Lakshadweep, East Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Marathwada, Sub Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim for today.
